description: AdvanVis - Smart Waterfall and Bridge draws waterfalls that add up and explains them in plain English: a profit and loss walk with its subtotals found for you, a bridge from budget or last year to actual from two measures, and a headline that says what moved the total. FREE FEATURES (no licence needed, no watermark) • Steps from a Category, or from several measures with no Category and no unpivoting • Subtotals found in your data (Gross profit, EBITDA), added after any step, or named • Costs stored as positive numbers are subtracted so the subtotals add up • Period chain with a Breakdown: each period a total, with what changed between them • Opening and closing totals, automatic with an override • Sort by size or direction, Top N with Other • Columns or bars, picked to fit the names and figures • A clearly marked axis break, so small steps stay readable beside large totals • Data labels with a second line (% of the first total, % of the total before, or change %), connector lines, a legend and a reference line (Analytics pane) • Step colours by rule (fx), and "Increase is good" for costs • Cross-highlighting, cross-filtering, drill-down, tooltips, Show condition • Basic headline, keyboard navigation, screen reader text and high contrast support PRO FEATURES (additional purchase may be required; one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource) • Bridge from Compare to or…
